{{Youmay|the [[Ta-Ree]] spell|[[Light (Ee)|Light]], the [[Ee mental power]]}}
'''Light''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to generate a bright light to illuminate a selected area. The spell [[Darkness (Ta-Ree spell)|darkness]] could neutralise the light spell.
